messages.summary:
## Objective
- Restyle the existing playable game, *The Hollowing*, with an original black-and-white psychological-horror manga aesthetic inspired by Junji Ito.

## Requirements
- Preserve the existing playable game; do not ask clarifying questions.
- User requested screenshots be saved as small JPEGs, viewport no wider than 1280px, and only the latest screenshot read.

## Decisions
- Applied an original ink-and-newsprint style using grayscale art, stipple textures, stark contrast, and restrained vermilion accents.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated the visual styles in `index.html`, preserving the existing game mechanics.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Chromium, confirmed the initial encounter displays five cards, played a card (enemy HP changed from 46 to 37), and ended the turn.
- Captured and inspected the latest screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/hollowing.jpg`.

### Active
- No active implementation work.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Review `index.html` changes and report completion, noting the styling is an original interpretation rather than a direct reproduction of any artist’s work.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game markup, styles, SVG art, and game logic.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Browser reported a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), unrelated to gameplay.
